newsitem.title: FRANCE: French SNCF, GdesEaux unit sign accord.
newsitem.headline: French SNCF, GdesEaux unit sign accord.

text.p: France's SNCF state railway and Generale des Eaux unit Cegetel said on Wednesday they signed a detailed agreement confirming their partnership in the development of an alternative telecommunications network.
In separate statements, SNCF and Cegetel said the agreement was signed on April 11. SNCF announced on February 12 that it chose Cegetel as its partner to run the telecommunications network.

The two said the network would be based on a telecommunications system already in place, developed by SNCF for its own use. Their goal was to offer service to customers across France beginning on January 1, 1998.
SNCF searched out a partner for the network after the French government granted a 15-year telecoms operating license to its Telecom Developpement unit in December.
Cegetel is a joint venture between Generale des Eaux, British Telecom Plc and Mannesman of Germany.
